_comment: Third parties that do not appear in the bundle graph (source map module list): libraries statically linked into MuPDF WASM, harfbuzz.wasm, fonts, the WASM runtime. The basis is in the evidence field. licenseFiles are paths relative to the directory of this file.

mupdfWasm.buildConfig: mupdf 1.28.1 platform/wasm/tools/build.sh 기본값: FEATURES="brotli=no mujs=no extract=no xps=no svg=no", emscripten 4.0.8. thirdparty 서브모듈 목록은 mupdf 1.28.1 태그의 thirdparty/(brotli, cmark-gfm, curl, extract, freeglut, freetype, gumbo-parser, harfbuzz, jbig2dec, lcms2, leptonica, libjpeg, mujs, openjpeg, tesseract, zint, zlib, zxing-cpp)이고, 위 기능 끄기와 WASM 바이너리 문자열 조사로 링크된 것을 골랐다.

entries.name: MuPDF WASM 에 내장: URW base35 글꼴(Nimbus Sans·Nimbus Roman·Nimbus Mono PS·Standard Symbols PS·Dingbats)
entries.notice: PDF 표준 14 글꼴 대체용으로 MuPDF 가 WASM 안에 넣은 CFF 글꼴이다. 라이선스는 mupdf 1.28.1 태그 resources/fonts/urw/OFL.txt(2026-10-21 확인)
entries.evidence: 'Copyright 2013/2014 by (URW)++ Design & Development', 'Copyright 2015 by URW' and the font name strings Nimbus Sans·Nimbus Roman·Nimbus Mono PS·Standard Symbols PS·Dingbats in mupdf-wasm.wasm

entries.name: WASM 런타임: Emscripten 과 musl 기반 libc
entries.license: MIT 또는 University of Illinois/NCSA (Emscripten), MIT (musl)
entries.evidence: mupdf-wasm.js is Emscripten-generated glue code; the WASM is linked with emcc

entries.name: harfbuzz.wasm (harfbuzzjs 1.6.2 에 포함)
entries.evidence: The harfbuzzjs package LICENSE is listed separately under the bundle graph entry (harfbuzzjs). This entry is the Old MIT notice for the HarfBuzz core inside the WASM (the same text as the HarfBuzz COPYING used by MuPDF above)
